design.notes: Matrix (booklet) item sampling. Delivered to SGPc as jurisdiction-level weighted marginal quantile arrays with the national-equivalent percentile; see the intake manifest.

enrollment.note: NAEP 2015 also assessed grade 12; not in the SGPc delivery. NAEP mathematics is not vertically equated across grades.

MATHEMATICS.notes: NCES currently styles the three reporting levels 'NAEP Basic', 'NAEP Proficient', 'NAEP Advanced'; the floor below the Basic cut is reported as below Basic. Labels kept in the ADR-013 draft shape. proficient_from = Proficient is the NCES 'at or above Proficient' reporting line, not a state policy target.

4.notes: NAEP mathematics grades 4 and 8 are reported on a 0-500 scale (NCES 2026-014 Table 3 note). Not a vertical scale.

8.notes: NAEP mathematics grades 4 and 8 are reported on a 0-500 scale (NCES 2026-014 Table 3 note). Not a vertical scale.

cutscores_provenance: MATHEMATICS only (maintainer first-pass). Grade 4: Basic 214 / Proficient 249 / Advanced 282. Grade 8: Basic 262 / Proficient 299 / Advanced 333. Source: NCES 2018-159 Table A-3 (2015 administration). The same three cuts are restated for 2022 in NCES 2026-014 Table 3, which notes they have been unchanged since the early-1990s achievement-level setting. Human promotes to reviewed (A3.4 gate).
notes: First-pass scope is MATHEMATICS. Grade-12 NAEP mathematics uses a different 0-300 scale and is not authored here.
